In this notebook, we analyze splenic TCR and BCR repertoires from mice immunized with one of three SARS-CoV-2 mRNA variants or PBS control. We use the AIRR-AlignR pipeline to explore pLM embedded sequences from a list of models. We then compile the embeddings into a single RDS file for each group of data.

[Paper source:](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2666379122001598)


Setting file and folder paths for the analysis
```{r, eval=FALSE}

dir.create(bench_raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(bench_processed_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

dir.create(embd_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

Accessing Bulk TCR/BCR-seq data from GEO

```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Access GEO data for the study
gse <- getGEO(accession, GSEMatrix =TRUE, getGPL=FALSE)
gseData <- gse[[1]]

# Download sample metadata
metadata <- pData(phenoData(gseData))
metadata %<>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type_ch1 = gsub(" ", "", cell_type_ch1),
    treatment_ch1 = gsub(" ", "-", treatment_ch1),
    group_dose =
      glue(
        "{cell_type_ch1}_{treatment_ch1}"
      ),
    group = case_when(
      grepl("-", group_dose) ~
        strex::str_before_first(group_dose, "-"),
      TRUE ~ group_dose
    )
  ) %>%
  glimpse()

write.csv(metadata,
  file =
    glue("{bench_raw_dir}/GSE201267/GSE201267_metadata.csv"),
    quote = TRUE,
    row.names = FALSE
)

#' pull down the supplementary files from GEO
#' These VDJ report files contain the TCR sequence data
supp_files <- getGEOSuppFiles(accession,
  makeDirectory = TRUE,
  baseDir = bench_raw_dir
)

# Uncompress tar file
shell_do(
  glue(
    " tar xvf {bench_raw_dir}/{accession}/{accession}.tar ."
  )
)

# unzip individual files
list.files(
  glue("{bench_raw_dir}/{accession}"),
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = ".tsv.gz"
) %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ shell_do(
      glue("gunzip {.}")
    )
  )
```

Next, we will extract the sequence data from the VDJ reports, select for high quality functional sequences, and format the data into fasta files.


```{r, eval=FALSE}

# function to read in tsv file, extract full length aa,
# and name sequences as list
format_vdj_aa <- function(file) {
  vdj_aa <- read_tsv(file) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sid = basename(vdj_reports[1]) %>%
        stringr::str_remove("_airr_rearrangement.tsv")
    ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("rowid") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sid = glue("{rowid}_{sid}_{junction_aa}_{duplicate_count}")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      productive,
      !grepl("\\*", sequence_aa)
    )
  return(vdj_aa)
}

vdj_reports <- list.files(
  glue("{bench_raw_dir}/{accession}"),
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = ".tsv"
)

#' loop through each tsv file, extract full length aa,
#' trim non-productive sequences with any stop codon
#' and write out as fasta files
vdj_reports %>%
  purrr::walk( ~ {
    file <- .x
    vdj_aa <- format_vdj_aa(file)
    seqinr::write.fasta(
      sequences = as.list(vdj_aa$sequence_aa),
      names = vdj_aa$sid,
      file.out = glue("{fasta_dir}/", 
        "{strex::str_before_first(basename(file), '_')}.fasta"),
      as.string = TRUE
      )
    })

```

Embedding sequences using the a list of pLM models

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# generating a data-frame of parameters to run embedding in parallel
batchtools_params <-
    expand.grid(
        c(list.files(fasta_dir, pattern = ".fasta", full.names = TRUE)),
        model_list
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate_all(as.character) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fasta = Var1, model = Var2) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        run_name = basename(fasta) %>% str_remove(".fasta"),
        output_dir = glue("{embd_dir}/{model}")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        output_exists = file.exists(
            glue("{output_dir}/{run_name}_{model}_AVG.csv")),
        output_size = case_when(
            output_exists ~ file.size(
                glue("{output_dir}/{run_name}_{model}_AVG.csv")), 
            TRUE ~ 0
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(output_size < 10) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(output_exists, output_size)) %>%
    glimpse()

# configure registry ----
cluster_run <- glue("{get_time()}_TRILL_embed_AIRR")
message("\n\nRUNNING:  ", cluster_run, "\n")
breg <- makeRegistry(
  file.dir = glue(
    "{wkdir}/.cluster_runs/",
    cluster_run
  ),
  seed = 42
)
breg$cluster.functions <- batchtools::makeClusterFunctionsSlurm(
  template = glue("{wkdir}/batchtools_templates/batchtools-trill-embed.tmpl"),
  scheduler.latency = 0.1,
  fs.latency = 1
)
# Submit Jobs ----
jobs <- batchMap(
  fun = trill_embed,
  args = batchtools_params,
  reg = breg
)
jobs[, chunk := chunk(job.id, chunk.size = 1)]
print(jobs[, .N, by = chunk])

submitJobs(jobs,
  resources = list(
    walltime = 60,
    memory_gpu = 30000,
    ncpus = 2,
    ngpus = 1,
    max.concurrent.jobs = 9999
  )
)

```

Loop through groups of data and compile embeddings into RDS files

```{r, eval=FALSE}

model_list <- c(
  "esm2_t12_35M",
  "esm2_t33_650M",
  "ProtT5-XL",
  "ProstT5",
  "Ankh",
  "Ankh-Large"
)

future::plan("multisession", workers = 16)
for (model in model_list) {
  embd_files <- list.files(
    path = glue("{embd_dir}/{model}"),
    pattern = ".csv",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  paths_df <- data.frame(path = embd_files) %>%
    mutate(
      geo_accession = basename(path) %>% str_remove(glue("_{model}_AVG.csv"))
    )

  for (grp in unique(metadata$group)) {
    output <- glue("{compiled_dir}/{grp}__{model}.rds")

    if (file.exists(output)) next
    message("Processing: ", model, " - ", grp, "...")

    meta_sub <- metadata %>%
      left_join(paths_df, by = "geo_accession") %>%
      filter(group == grp)

    agg_embd <- meta_sub$path %>%
      purrr::set_names(basename(.)) %>%
      furrr::future_map(
        ~ read.csv(.x) %>% as.data.table()
      ) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "path") %>% 
      mutate(group = grp)
    saveRDS(agg_embd, output)
  }
}

```


### Analysis 

Loading ProstT5 model embeddings for all TCR data, and formatting into dlist object.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
model <- "ProstT5"
groups_align <- c(
  "Tcell_PBS",
  "Tcell_B.1.351", 
  "Tcell_WA1", 
  "Tcell_B.1.617"
)

res <- groups_align %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ readRDS(
      glue("{compiled_dir}/{.}__{model}.rds")
    ) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(Label = 
        glue("{gsub('_AVG.csv', '', path)}_{Label}__{group}")) %>%
      dplyr::select(-path) %>% 
      # TODO: quick fix for duplicate labels
      dplyr::group_by(Label) %>%
      dplyr::slice_sample(n = 1) %>% 
      dplyr::ungroup()
      ) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    glimpse()

dlist <- res %>%
  distinct() %>%
  column_to_rownames("Label") %>%
  split_train_test(
    m = .,
    split_col = "group",
    remove_cols = c("group")
  )

# visualize the data dimensions
names(dlist) %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(~ dim(dlist[[.]]))

```

AIRR-AlignR Exectution. Loop through conditions and align all with PBS Tcell data.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
reference = "Tcell_PBS"

for (target in c("Tcell_B.1.351", "Tcell_WA1", "Tcell_B.1.617")) {
  results_dir <- glue(
    "{analysis_res_dir}/",
    "REF_{reference}__TARGET_{target}__{model}"
  )
  set.seed(42)
  gmm_aligner(
    dlist = dlist,
    ref_group = reference,
    test_group = target,
    optimal_cluster_n = 40,
    threads = 6,
    n_ica_comp = 30,
    output_path = results_dir,
    overwrite = TRUE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}

```


Aggregating aligned cluster results for all Tcell samples
```{r, eval=FALSE}

aligned_gmm_paths <- list.dirs(analysis_res_dir) %>%
  keep(grepl("REF_Tcell_PBS", .) & grepl("_ProstT5", .)) %>% 
  list.files(., full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  keep(grepl("GMM-alignment.rds", .))

aligned_gmm_labels <- aligned_gmm_paths %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ readRDS(.)[["gmm_class_map"]] %>%
      dplyr::select(Label, grouping, aligned_mixture)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  distinct() %>% # to remove redundant ref.
  glimpse()


```

Parameter analysis of GMM components

```{r, eval=FALSE}

# parameter analysis of GMMs across groups

aligned_gmm_labels <- aligned_gmm_paths %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ readRDS(.)[["gmm_class_map"]] %>%
      dplyr::select(Label, grouping, aligned_mixture)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  distinct() %>% # to remove redundant ref.
  glimpse()

# Aggregating aligned cluster results for all Tcell samples
analysis_dirs <- list.dirs(analysis_res_dir) %>%
  keep(grepl("REF_Tcell_PBS", .) & grepl("_ProstT5", .))
gmm_param_analysis_df <- tibble()

for (dir in analysis_dirs) {
  pair_map_df <- readRDS(glue("{dir}/GMM-alignment.rds"))$pair_map_df
  gmm_res <- readRDS(glue("{dir}/GMMs.rds"))
  gmm_groups <- names(gmm_res)

  pair_map_clean_plot <- calculate_gmm_param_analysis(
    pair_map_df = pair_map_df,
    gmm_ref = gmm_res[[1]],
    gmm_test = gmm_res[[2]]
  ) %>%
    mutate_at(vars(ref_components, test_components), as.character) %>%
    mutate(
      analysis_dir = dir,
      gmm1 = gmm_groups[1],
      gmm2 = gmm_groups[2],
    ) %>%
    glimpse()
  gmm_param_analysis_df %<>% bind_rows(pair_map_clean_plot)
}

gmm_param_analysis_df %>% glimpse

p_du <- gmm_param_analysis_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(ref_components, delta_w), y = delta_mu)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = gmm2), size = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_npg() +
    labs(
      color = NULL,
      x = "Aligned Mixture",
      y = expression(Delta * mu[i])) +
    theme_light()

p_w <- gmm_param_analysis_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(ref_components, delta_w), y = delta_w)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = gmm2), size = 2) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_color_npg() +
    labs(
      color = NULL,
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(Delta * omega[i])) +
    theme_light()

p_sigma <- gmm_param_analysis_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(ref_components, delta_w), y = delta_sigma)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = gmm2), size = 2) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_color_npg() +
    labs(
      color = NULL,
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(Delta * Sigma[i])) +
    theme_light()

p_gmm_params <- p_du %>%
  aplot::insert_right(p_w) %>%
  aplot::insert_right(p_sigma)

ggsave(p_gmm_params,
  file = glue(
    "{wkdir}/figures/AIRR/benchmarks/",
    "Tcells_ProstT5_param-analysis_{Sys.Date()}.png"
  ),
  width = 10, height = 7
)
```

Earth movers distance 

```{r, eval=FALSE}

pca_df <- readRDS(
  glue("{bench_processed_dir}/GSE201267/PCA_Tcells_ProstT5_2024-04-01.rds")) %>%
  glimpse()

pca_df %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_before_first(Label, "_")) %>%
  pull(sample_id) %>%
  table()

# Computing earth movers distance between samples
pca_df_ot <- pca_df %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_before_first(Label, "_")) %>%
  glimpse()

sids <- unique(pca_df_ot$sample_id)

pca_df_ot %>% glimpse
pca_df_ot$sample_id %>% table()


# computing all unique combinations of sample pairs
sid_pairs <- expand.grid(sids, sids) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id1 = Var1,
    sample_id2 = Var2
  )

# 100 random subsamples with 50 rec per match
tic()
future::plan("multisession", workers = 40)
earth_movers_distance_df <- furrr::future_map2_dfr(
    sid_pairs$sample_id1, sid_pairs$sample_id2,
    ~ run_earth_movers_subsamples(
      pca_df_ot, s1 = .x, s2 = .y, n = 1000, iter = 50,
      cols_to_filter = c("sample_id", "Label", "group"),
      split_var = "sample_id"
      ),
      seed=TRUE
)
toc()

saveRDS(
    earth_movers_distance_df,
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/interim/airr/benchmark/GSE201267",
        "earth_movers_distance_df_{model}_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
    )
)

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}

earth_movers_distance_df <- readRDS(

earth_movers_distance_df_plot <- earth_movers_distance_df %>% 
  left_join(sid_annot %>% dplyr::rename("group1" = group),
    by = c("id1" = "sample_id")
  ) %>%
  left_join(sid_annot %>% dplyr::rename("group2" = group),
    by = c("id2" = "sample_id")
  ) %>%
      mutate(group_pair = case_when(
        (group1 == group2) & (group1 == "Tcell_PBS") ~ "Within PBS",
        (group1 == group2) & (group1 == "Tcell_B.1.351") ~ "Within B.1.351",
        (group1 == group2) & (group1 == "Tcell_WA1") ~ "Within WA1",
        (group1 == group2) & (group1 == "Tcell_B.1.617") ~ "Within B.1.617",
        # other
        group1 == "Tcell_PBS" & group2 == "Tcell_B.1.351" ~ "PBS to B.1.351",
        group1 == "Tcell_PBS" & group2 == "Tcell_B.1.617" ~ "PBS to B.1.617",
        group1 == "Tcell_PBS" & group2 == "Tcell_WA1" ~ "PBS to WA1",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )) %>%
      # pull(group_pair) %>% table
    glimpse()


p_emd_dist <- earth_movers_distance_df_plot %>%
  filter(group_pair != "Other") %>%
  filter(id1 != id2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group_pair, y = median)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Median Earth Movers Distance") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(p_emd_dist,
  file = glue(
    "{wkdir}/figures/AIRR/benchmarks/",
    "Tcells_ProstT5_EMD_distributions_{Sys.Date()}.png"
  ),
  width = 5, height = 5
)
```
